:::{#exm-complement-set-difference}
#### The complement of "the roll is even" as a set difference

For the fair die in @exm-sample-space,
the sample space is $\samplespace = \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$.
For the event "the roll is even", $A = \set{2, 4, 6}$,
the set difference is $\setdiff{\samplespace}{A} = \set{1, 3, 5}$,
which is the complement $\neg A$ in @exm-complement.
